commitments.statement: After a successful Change abandonment from Cockpit, a confirmation naming the Change and stating that it is now in Change history remains visible until the user dismisses it, independent of the Change detail closing.

The confirmation is a dismissible notice owned by the Delivery portfolio page; the existing automatic navigation to Change history is kept; no auto-dismissing toast or shell-wide notification mechanism is introduced.
The abandonment request, reason requirement, confirmation dialog, failure handling, auto-navigation focus behavior, and Change history retention of abandoned records are unchanged.

acceptance: AC-001: Given an open Change publication detail whose abandonment succeeds and whose Change then leaves the current portfolio, Cockpit shows Change history and a notice containing the Change title and stating that the Change is now in Change history.

AC-002: Given the abandonment notice is shown, it remains visible across subsequent portfolio refreshes and switches between Current delivery and Change history until the user activates its dismiss control, after which it is no longer rendered.
AC-003: Given the abandonment request fails, no abandonment notice is shown and the confirmation dialog stays open with the error, as before.
AC-004: Given the abandonment notice is shown, it is exposed with role status and has a keyboard-operable dismiss button with an accessible name referencing the abandonment confirmation.
AC-005: Given the changed Cockpit frontend, in serve/cockpit/web the WorkPortfolio Vitest files, npx tsc -b, and Biome check scoped to the changed files through scripts/run-biome-check.mjs pass.
outcomes.promise: After abandoning a Change, the user reads a confirmation naming the Change and stating it is in Change history, and it stays until they dismiss it.
outcomes.title: Persistent abandonment confirmation

acceptance_observations: AC-001: In WorkPortfolio.part3, after confirming abandonment on /delivery/change-alpha/publication and switching fixtureState.currentPortfolio to one without change-alpha, the Change history view becomes active (the `[data-workspace-view="history"]` control receives focus as before) and a role="status" element contains the Change title "Portfolio redesign" and "is now in Change history".

AC-002: With the notice shown in Change history, after switching to Current delivery via the view switch and waiting for a new portfolio GET recorded in fixtureState.requests (history pauses interval polling), then switching back to Change history, the notice text is still rendered in both views; after activating the dismiss control, no element with the notice text is rendered.

AC-003: In the existing failure test (mutationFailurePath "/abandon"), the alertdialog still shows the rejection error and "Confirm Change abandonment", and no element containing "is now in Change history" is rendered.

AC-004: getByRole("status") containing the notice text holds a p-button host; after PDS hydration (waitFor), that host's shadowRoot contains a native <button> whose accessible name (text or aria-label, as asserted on the shadow button) matches /dismiss abandonment confirmation/i; calling focus() on that shadow button makes host.shadowRoot.activeElement the button (document.activeElement is the p-button host); dispatching its click (the activation a native button performs for keyboard Enter/Space) removes the notice.

AC-005: In serve/cockpit/web: `npx vitest run src/__tests__/WorkPortfolio` (WorkPortfolio.part1-5 and hostJourney files) passes; `npx tsc -b` exits 0; `node scripts/run-biome-check.mjs check serve/cockpit/web/src/pages/WorkPortfolioPage.tsx serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/WorkPortfolio.part3.test.tsx` (plus serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/workPortfolioHarness.tsx if changed) exits 0.
constraints: Keep WorkItemDetail's `onAbandonChange: (reason) => Promise<Error | null>` contract and ChangeDispositionSection unchanged.
Leave the selected-Change-left-portfolio effect, its navigation to /delivery/history, and history-view focus restoration unchanged.
Notice is in-memory WorkPortfolioPage state rendered outside the PFlyout; use Porsche Design System components and existing Tailwind tokens (border-l-4 border-success bg-surface).
Call onAbandoned only when the abandonment request resolves without error.
exclusions: No auto-dismissing PToast, no shell-wide/global notification mechanism, no persistence across reload or leaving the Delivery page.
No backend, API client, or useWorkItems hook changes; no change to abandonment request payload, reason requirement, confirmation dialog, or failure handling.
No changes to Change history retention of abandoned records.
maintained_surfaces: serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/workPortfolioHarness.tsx (only if a fixture helper is needed)
proof_boundaries: WorkPortfolioPage rendered through the existing workPortfolioHarness fixture HTTP layer in jsdom Vitest (WorkPortfolio.part3.test.tsx), exercising the real useWorkItemDetail/WorkItemDetail abandonment flow and the page's navigation effect.
TypeScript project build (`npx tsc -b`) and Biome scoped to changed files via scripts/run-biome-check.mjs from serve/cockpit/web with repository-root-relative paths.
Real-browser keyboard focus and PDS shadow-DOM behavior beyond jsdom are not proven (accepted design weakness; jsdom only).
required_outputs: serve/cockpit/web/src/pages/WorkPortfolioPage.tsx with page-owned abandonment notice state, `onAbandoned` prop on SelectedDetail/SelectedWorkItemDetail, and the page-level notice with PDS dismiss control
serve/cockpit/web/src/__tests__/WorkPortfolio.part3.test.tsx tests for the success notice lifecycle, accessibility, and failure no-notice assertion
tasks.result: WorkPortfolioPage holds `abandonedNotice: {changeId, title} | null`; SelectedWorkItemDetail/SelectedDetail receive `onAbandoned(changeId, title)` and wrap `selectedDetail.abandonChange` so the title captured from the available detail (`detail.item.change_title`) is reported only when the request returns null; the page renders a dismissible success notice ("<title> was abandoned and is now in Change history.", role="status", success styling, PDS dismiss PButton labelled "Dismiss abandonment confirmation") above the workspace content and outside the PFlyout in both Current delivery and Change history views; a later abandonment replaces it; WorkPortfolio Vitest coverage proves persistence, dismissal, accessibility, and failure suppression.
tasks.title: Page-owned persistent abandonment notice in WorkPortfolioPage
